blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Typed decision models such as Jev offer an efficient alternative to generative LLMs in decision-making workflows by selecting directly from predefined options. When candidate sets contain no valid answer, TypeSafe recommends including an "other" or “none-of-the-above” option to enable rejection. In this report, however, we identify an arithmetic-dependent rejection bottleneck : Jev reliably selects correct numerical answers when available but frequently accepts incorrect alternatives when they are absent despite an explicit rejection option. On paired arithmetic problems, answer-present accuracy reaches 99%, while correct rejection falls to 7%. Moreover, this gap persists across numerical magnitudes, operation depths, contextual formulations, and rejection labels, and extends to scenarios such as time calculation and capacity rounding. Yet native Boolean verification achieves 99% exact-match accuracy on the same answer-absent arithmetic cases, showing that categorical rejection can fail even when the model successfully verifies candidate correctness. Finally, we show that a simple decision threshold selected on separate development problems raises arithmetic rejection accuracy from 7% to 79% while retaining 97% answer-present accuracy, substantially mitigating the failure without retraining or additional inference.
blocks.zh: Jev等类型化决策模型通过直接从预定义的选项中选择,为决策工作流程中的基因LLMs提供了高效的替代品. 当候选人集没有有效答案时,TypeSafe建议包括一个“其他”或“以上无”选项,以便能够拒绝。 然而,我们在本报告中指出一个依赖算术的拒绝瓶颈: Jev可靠地选择正确的数字答案,如果有,但经常接受错误的替代方案,尽管有明确的拒绝选项,却不存在。 在对齐的算术问题上,答题的准确度达到99%,而正确的拒绝率下降到7%。 此外,这一差距在数值、操作深度、上下文配方和拒绝标签之间继续存在,并延伸到时间计算和能力四舍五入等情况。 然而,本地布尔校验在同一解答偏差的算术案例中实现了99%的精确比对,表明即使模型成功验证了候选人的正确性,绝对拒绝也可能失败. 最后,我们显示,对不同的发展问题选择一个简单的决定阈值,将算术拒绝精度从7%提高到79%,同时保留97%的答录精度,在不进行再培训或附加推论的情况下大幅度缓解失败。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Typed decision models such as Jev TypeSafe AI (2026b) have emerged as an efficient alternative to generative large language models (LLMs) ( OpenAI, 2023 ; Gemini Team, 2023 ; Anthropic, 2024 ) for decision-making workflows. Unlike generative LLMs that produce token sequences autoregressively, Jev accepts a description of the current state and predefined output criteria, then directly returns structured categorical, Boolean, or ordinal judgments ( TypeSafe AI, 2026a ; TypeSafe AI, 2026b ) . This makes it a natural component for workflows that require bounded decisions rather than generated explanations, such as in record, action selection and policy evaluation.
blocks.zh: Jev TypeSafe AI(2026b)等打字决策模型作为基因大语言模型(LLMs)的有效替代品出现(OpenAI,2023;双子座团队,2023;Anthropic,2024)用于决策工作流程. 与以自动递归方式产生令牌序列的基因LLMS不同,Jev接受对当前状态和预定义输出标准的描述,然后直接返回结构化的断断,Boolean,或普通判断(TypeSafe AI,2026a;TypeSafe AI,2026b). 这使它成为工作流程的一个自然组成部分,这些工作流程要求作出有限度的决定,而不是在记录、行动选择和政策评价中作出解释。

blocks.en: However, predefined candidate sets need not contain a valid answer. For example, in payment reconciliation, a system matching a $100 payment to retrieved invoices must reject all candidates if none has charges minus credits totaling $100. Recognizing when to reject is therefore essential for reliable decisions, as emphasized by research on LLM abstention ( Wen et al., 2025 ; Madhusudhan et al., 2025 ; Tomani et al., 2024 ; Kirichenko et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . To support rejection, TypeSafe recommends including an other or none-of-the-above option ( TypeSafe AI, 2026a ) . This raises a basic question: if a model can select the correct answer, can it also recognize when every supplied answer is wrong?
blocks.zh: 然而,预先定义的候选人集不需要包含有效的答案. 例如,在对付款进行核对时,如果没有任何候选人的收费减去共计100美元的贷项,那么将100美元的付款与收回的发票相匹配的系统必须拒绝所有候选人。 因此,正如关于LLM弃权的研究所强调的(Wen等人,2025年;Madhusudhan等人,2025年;Tomani等人,2024年;Kirichenko等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年),承认何时拒绝对可靠决定至关重要。 为了支持拒绝,TypeSafe建议包括一个其他的或者没有以上选项(TypeSafe AI,2026a). 这提出了一个基本的问题:如果一个模型可以选择正确的答案,它能否也识别每个提供的答复都是错误的?

blocks.en: We study this question through paired answer-present and answer-absent menus with exact ground truth. Surprisingly, Jev achieves 99% answer-present accuracy on bare arithmetic, even simple two-operation arithmetic ( a + b − c a+b-c ), yet correctly rejects only 7% of answer-absent menus despite an explicit “None" option ( Figure 1 a). This rejection gap extends beyond bare expressions to arithmetic-dependent scenarios, including inventory updates, purchase totals, and time calculations. Moreover, rejection already collapses with just two elementary operations, showing that the failure arises even under minimal computational demands ( Figure 1 b). Together, these results highlight why high selection accuracy alone is an incomplete measure of reliability.
blocks.zh: 我们通过配对的答题和答题菜单来研究这个问题。 令人惊讶的是,Jev在赤裸的算术上,甚至简单的双操作算术(a + b − c a + b-c)上都实现了99%的答录率准确度,然而,尽管有一个明确的“无”选项(图1a),但正确拒绝的答录菜单只有7%。 这一拒绝差距超越了赤裸的表达方式,而扩展到依赖算术的情景,包括库存更新、采购总额和时间计算。 此外,由于只有两项基本操作,拒绝已经崩溃,这表明即使在最低计算要求下也会出现失败(图1b)。 这些结果共同突出了为什么单是高选择准确性就不完整地衡量可靠性。

blocks.en: To identify the source of this bottleneck, we examine both the required computation and the decision interface. Native Boolean verification correctly rejects all three candidates on 99% of answer-absent arithmetic cases, demonstrating that Jev can evaluate their numerical correctness. Similarly, providing the correct numerical result directly restores perfect Menu Choice rejection with the same candidates. We further introduce candidate-level T/F Choice, which preserves the Boolean verification questions but uses categorical outputs. Its substantially lower accuracy shows that individual verification alone does not resolve the failure; the decision interface remains consequential.
blocks.zh: 为了确定这一瓶颈的根源,我们审查了所需的计算和决策接口。 原生布尔校验在99%的答题算术病例上正确拒绝所有三个候选人,表明Jev可以评价他们的数值正确性. 同样,提供正确的数字结果直接恢复了与相同候选人的完美菜单选择拒绝. 我们还引入了候选的T/F级选择,它保留了布尔核查问题,但使用绝对的产出。 其准确性大大降低,表明单靠个别核查不能解决故障;决策接口仍然是必然的。

blocks.en: We therefore ask whether rejection can be improved within Menu Choice itself and find that its output scores retain a useful rejection signal even when the selected answer is incorrect ( Figure 1 c). Motivated by this, we propose a simple threshold calibration and show that a threshold selected on separate development problems raises arithmetic rejection from 7% to 79% while retaining 97% answer-present accuracy, without retraining or additional inference ( Figure 1 d).
blocks.zh: 因此,我们询问在菜单选择本身内部是否可以改进拒绝,并发现其产出分数保留了一个有用的拒绝信号,即使所选答案不正确(图1c). 以此为动力,我们提议了一个简单的阈值校准,并表明在不同的发展问题上选定的阈值将算术拒绝率从7%提高到79%,同时保留97%的答题精确度,而不进行再培训或附加推论(图1d)。

blocks.en: • We identify an arithmetic-dependent rejection bottleneck : Jev reliably selects valid answers but frequently fails to reject invalid candidate sets. • We conduct extensive ablations, controlled comparisons, and error analyses to characterize the roles of computation, decision interface, and task formulation. • We propose a simple threshold calibration that substantially improves rejection while retaining high selection accuracy, without retraining or additional inference.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们发现一个依赖算术的拒绝瓶颈: Jev可靠地选择了有效的答案,但经常没有拒绝无效的候选集. ^ 我们进行广泛的模拟、有控制的比较和错误分析,以说明计算、决策接口和任务拟订的作用。 我们提出一个简单的阈值校准,大大改进拒绝,同时保持高精度的选择,而不进行再培训或附加推论。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Prior work examines least-incorrect answer selection ( Wang et al., 2025 ) and domain-dependent degradation under none-of-the-above questions ( Tam et al., 2025 ) . More broadly, studies of LLM abstention document failures on unanswerable questions ( Madhusudhan et al., 2025 ; Kirichenko et al., 2025 ; Wen et al., 2025 ) and explore uncertainty-based rejection ( Tomani et al., 2024 ) . We study this distinction in typed decision APIs, isolating an arithmetic-dependent rejection bottleneck through matched interface comparisons and computation controls, then evaluating threshold calibration as a repair.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作审查了最不正确的答案选择(Wang等人,2025年)和无以上问题下依赖域的退化(Tam等人,2025年)。 更广泛地说,关于LLM弃权的研究记录了无法回答的问题的失败(Madhusudhan等人,2025年;Kirichenko等人,2025年;Wen等人,2025年),并探讨基于不确定性的拒绝(Tomani等人,2024年)。 我们通过匹配的接口比较和计算控制来研究这种在打字决定API中的区别,将一个依赖算术的拒绝瓶颈隔离,然后评价阈值校准作为修复.

blocks.en: TypeSafe documents mathematical limitations and Boolean/Choice inconsistencies ( TypeSafe AI, 2026b ) . Sun and Xu (2026) study option-name/rubric conflicts, while Zhang et al. (2026) examine request configuration on ContractNLI. In contrast, we isolate exact numerical rejection under explicit false and None alternatives. Alternative-label controls connect this analysis to schema sensitivity without reducing the phenomenon to a particular identifier.
blocks.zh: TypeSafe记录了数学限制和Boolean/Choice不一致(TypeSafe AI, 2026b). Sun和Xu(2026)研究选项名称/rubric冲突,而Zhang等人(2026)则在ContractNLI上审查请求配置. 与此相反,我们以明显的虚假和没有其他选择来孤立确切的数字拒绝。 替代标签控制将这种分析与计划敏感性联系起来,而不将现象降低到特定的标识符.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 4 实验和结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Our main evaluation uses 100 problems each for two-operation arithmetic ( a + b − c a+b-c ), numerical lookup, and purchase totals ( q ​ p + s qp+s ). Arithmetic samples a ∈ [ 300,999 ] a\in[300,999] and b , c ∈ [ 10 , 99 ] b,c\in[10,99] ; purchase totals use q ∈ [ 3 , 11 ] q\in[3,11] , p ∈ [ 11 , 59 ] p\in[11,59] , and s ∈ [ 5 , 24 ] s\in[5,24] . Present menus use answer offsets { − 2 , 0 , + 3 } \{-2,0,+3\} and absent menus use { − 2 , + 1 , + 3 } \{-2,+1,+3\} , preserving the facts and two distractors while shuffling candidate order within each coverage condition. All interfaces receive the same menus; arithmetic and lookup additionally share answers and candidate text. Contextual controls comprise 128 inventory problems and 64 problems each for refund policy and logical eligibility. Subsequent experiments vary computation depth, numerical magnitude, candidate distance, operator structure, task family, and rejection encoding.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要评价是,两个操作算术(a + b − c a + b-c ),数字检索和购买总额(q p + s qp +s ),各使用100个问题。 算术样本 a ∈ [300,999] a\ in [300,999] 和 b, c ∈ [10,99] b, c\ in [10,99] ; 购买总量使用 q ∈ [3, 11] q in [3, 11], p ∈ [11, 59] p\ [11, 59] 和 s ∈ [5, 24] s\ in [5, 24]. 目前的菜单使用答案抵消 {− 2, 0, + 3} → 2, 0, + 3} 和缺菜单使用 {− 2, + 1, + 3} → → 2, + 1,+ 3} , 保留事实和两个分心器,同时在每一个覆盖条件内打乱候选顺序. 所有接口都收到相同的菜单;算术和检索额外共享答案和候选文本. 背景控制包括128个库存问题和64个退款政策和逻辑资格问题。 随后的实验有不同的计算深度,数值大小,候选距离,操作者结构,任务家族,以及拒绝编码.

blocks.en: We evaluate Jev and record structured predictions and probabilities. Programmatic generators provide exact ground truth. Menu accuracy scores the selected option. Candidate verification requires all three truth labels to be correct. We additionally use Qwen3.5-9B (w/ Reasoning) as a generative LLM control on the same menus.
blocks.zh: 我们评价Jev,并记录结构化预测和概率。 程序生成器提供准确的地面真相. 菜单精度评分选定选项 。 候选人验证要求所有三个真相标签都正确. 我们额外使用Quen3.5-9B(w/Reasoning)作为同一菜单上的基因LLM控制.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results: The Rejection Bottleneck
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要内容 结果:拒绝点阵

blocks.en: Menu Choice achieves 99% answer-present accuracy on simple arithmetic but only 7% correct rejection, a 92-point paired gap. Purchase totals show the same pattern: 94% versus 24%, a 70-point gap ( Figure 3 ). Thus, successful selection does not imply reliable rejection when the correct answer is missing.
blocks.zh: 菜单选择(Menu Choice)在简单的算术上实现了99%的答案-呈现精度,但只有7%的正确拒绝,这是92分的对位差距. 采购总额显示的格局相同:94%对24%,差距为70点(图3)。 因此,在缺少正确答案时,成功的选择并不意味着可靠的拒绝。

blocks.en: Contextual inventory extends the effect beyond bare expressions, with 127/128 correct selections but only 14/128 correct rejections. In contrast, refund-policy and logical-eligibility controls achieve 64/64 under both coverage conditions across all tested interfaces. The bottleneck therefore depends on the task rather than arising whenever a rejection option is needed. These earlier contextual categorical-verification controls use neutral identifiers rather than literal T/F labels.
blocks.zh: 上下文目录将效果延伸至赤色表达之外,有127/128正确选择,但只有14/128正确拒绝. 与此相反,退款政策和逻辑资格控制在所有测试接口的两种覆盖条件下都达到了64/64。 因此,瓶颈取决于任务,而不是在需要拒绝选择时出现。 这些早期的上下文绝对验证控制使用中性标识,而不是文字上的T/F标签.

blocks.en: 4.3 Isolating Computation and Interface Effects
blocks.zh: 4.3 孤立计算和接口效应

blocks.en: To isolate computation from numerical candidate matching, we supply the correct result directly while preserving the arithmetic answers and menus. All three interfaces achieve 100% accuracy under both coverage conditions. For Menu Choice, rejection rises from 7% to 100%: the same numerical candidates support reliable rejection when calculation is removed.
blocks.zh: 为了从数字候选人匹配中分离计算,我们在保留算术答案和菜单的同时,直接提供正确的结果. 所有三种接口在两种覆盖条件下都实现了100%的准确性. 对于菜单选择,拒绝率从7%上升到100%:在删除计算时,同样的数字候选人支持可靠的拒绝.

blocks.en:
To separate decomposition from question type, we compare candidate-level T/F Choice with native Boolean, changing only the type field in matched payloads. On answer-absent arithmetic, exact-match accuracy rises from 27% to 99%; purchase totals show the same direction of improvement. Thus checking candidates individually does not resolve the failure: the same verification questions produce substantially different accuracy across interfaces.
For example, given 674 + 27 − 60 = 641 674+27-60=641 and candidates ( 642,639,644 ) (642,639,644) , Menu Choice and T/F Choice both accept 639, whereas Boolean correctly rejects all three. The failure therefore persists under categorical verification even when native Boolean verification succeeds.
blocks.zh:
为了将分解与问题类型区分开来,我们将候选级别T/F选择与原生布尔进行对比,仅改变匹配有效载荷中的类型场. 在答错算术中,精确的比对精度从27%上升到99%;购买总量显示同样的改进方向. 因此,逐个检查候选人并不能解决故障:同样的核查问题在界面之间产生的准确性大不相同。
例如,给674+27 − 60 = 641 674+27-60=641和考生(642 639 644) (642 639 644),菜单选择和T/F选择都接受639,而布尔正确拒绝所有三个. 因此,即使在本土布尔核查成功的情况下,这种失败仍然受到绝对的核查。

blocks.en: Figure 5: A capable generative control. Qwen3.5-9B (w/ reasoning) on the same cases per family and coverage. P/A denotes present/absent. Both computational menus are solved perfectly. Token-limit failures account for 66 of 67 errors across menu and joint-verification responses, distinguishing output completion from valid incorrect decisions.
blocks.zh: 图5:有能力的基因控制。 Quen3.5-9B(w/推理),涉及每个家庭和覆盖面相同的案件。 P/A表示在场/缺席。 两个计算菜单都完美解决. 在菜单和联合核查答复的67个错误中,收件限制失败占66个,将产出完成与正确的错误决定区分开来。

blocks.en: To test whether the candidate construction itself prevents rejection, we evaluate reasoning-enabled Qwen3.5-9B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) using menu and joint-verification prompts on the identical transfer cases. Figure 5 shows that Qwen reaches 100% present and absent menu accuracy on both arithmetic and purchase totals. Lookup scores 99%/94%, with all seven errors caused by truncation. Joint-verification accuracy is 92%/79% for arithmetic, 89%/90% for lookup, and 92%/97% for purchase. Overall, 66 of 67 errors are truncations. The perfect computational-menu results establish that the same candidate sets permit reliable rejection.
blocks.zh: 为了检验候选建筑本身是否防止拒绝,我们用菜单和联合核查的提示,对相同的转移案件进行推理化的Quen3.5-9B(Quen Team,2026年)评价. 图5显示,Quen在计算总数和购买总数上均达到100%的现成和缺菜单准确度。 检查得分99%/94%,所有7个错误都是由截断造成的. 联合核查的精确度是:算术92%/79%,检查89%/90%,购买92%/97%。 总的来说,67个错误中有66个是短音。 完美的计算菜单结果确定,同一套候选人可以可靠地拒绝。

blocks.en: 4.4 Depth, Magnitude, and Operator Structure
blocks.zh: 4.4 深度、强度和操作结构

blocks.en: We vary additive depth from zero (the result is supplied) to five operations on 50 paired base cases, preserving answers and candidates. Menu present/absent accuracy falls from 100%/66% at one operation to 98%/4% at two. Boolean retains 90%/92% at two operations and 84%/90% at four. At five, Boolean declines to 58%/66%, while Menu selection remains 90% and rejection is 2%. Categorical rejection thus deteriorates well before Boolean verification ( Figure 4 a).
blocks.zh: 我们把添加剂的深度从零(结果提供)到50对基本病例的5次操作,保留答案和候选人。 菜单的现/缺精率从一次手术的100%/66%下降到两次手术的98%/4%。 布尔在两次操作中保留90%/92%,在四次操作中保留84%/90%. 5岁时,布尔率下降到58%/66%,而菜单选择率仍为90%,被拒绝率为2%. 因此,在布尔核查(图4a)之前,分类拒绝就恶化了。

blocks.en: To isolate magnitude, we generate 100 fresh two-operation a + b − c a+b-c problems in each band: 1–9, 10–99, 100–999, 1,000–9,999, and 10,000–99,999. Operands, intermediate sums, and answers remain within the band; distractor offsets stay fixed. Selection is 100%, 100%, 99%, 99%, and 99%, respectively, whereas rejection is 56%, 8%, 14%, 11%, and 14%. Failure therefore occurs even within 1–9 and remains severe, without a monotonic magnitude trend, across larger bands ( Figure 4 b).
blocks.zh: 为了分离体积,我们产生100个新的双操作 a + b − c a + b − c 每个波段的问题: 1–9, 10–99, 100–999, 1000–9,999, 10–999。 操作、中间金额和答案仍保留在频段内;分流器抵消时保持不变。 选择率分别为100%、100%、99%、99%和99%,而拒绝率分别为56%、8%、14%、11%和14%。 因此,失败甚至在1至9年内发生,在较大波段之间仍然很严重,没有单一的幅度趋势(图4b)。

blocks.en: To distinguish candidate proximity from problem magnitude, we give 50 shared inventory cases absent candidates at absolute-error bands 1–5, 20–25, 90–100, and 195–200. Menu rejection increases from 20% to 88%, and T/F exact rejection from 16% to 84%. In contrast, Boolean declines from 100% to 84% ( Figure 4 c). Increasing numerical separation helps categorical rejection but does not produce a common difficulty ordering across interfaces.
blocks.zh: 为了区分候选人的接近程度和问题的严重程度,我们在绝对异常波段1 - 5、20 - 25、90 - 100和195 - 200给出了50个共用清单候选人。 菜单拒绝率从20%增加到88%,T/F确切拒绝率从16%增加到84%。 相比之下,布尔从100%下降到84%(图4c)。 增加数字分离有助于断然拒绝,但不会产生跨接口命令的共同困难。

blocks.en: Table 1: Rejection varies with operator composition. Multiplication/division chains achieve higher rejection accuracy than expressions combining these operations with addition or subtraction.
blocks.zh: 表1:拒绝因运营商构成而异。 乘法/分割链比将这些运算与增减相结合的表达式实现更高的拒绝精度.

blocks.en: To test beyond additive arithmetic, we evaluate 50 single multiplications, 50 exact divisions, and 100 two-operation problems (10 per pattern), using standard precedence and exact integer division. Two-operation cases retain the original operand ranges and positive answers. Single multiplication and division retain high rejection accuracy (98% and 96%), whereas combining these operators with addition or subtraction reproduces the selection–rejection gap ( Table 1 ). The bottleneck thus extends beyond additive expressions while remaining sensitive to operator composition.
blocks.zh: 为了测试添加剂算术之外,我们用标准优先和精确整数的划分来评价50个单倍乘法,50个精确的分法,以及100个双操作问题(每个模式10个). 双行动案保留了最初的操作范围和正面答案. 单一乘法和除法保留了高的拒绝精度(98%和96%),而将这些操作符加增或减法合并则复制了选择-拒绝差距(表1)。 因此,瓶颈超出了添加剂的表达范围,同时对操作者成分保持敏感。

blocks.en: 4.5 Task Transfer and Rejection Encoding
blocks.zh: 4.5 任务传输和拒绝编码

blocks.en: Figure 6: Rejection gaps extend to other arithmetic-dependent tasks. Menu Choice results across 15 pilot families, with 20 paired cases each. Time calculation, capacity rounding, and calendar arithmetic show selection–rejection gaps, while several symbolic tasks succeed under both conditions. Time and counting show their initial pilot results; the dotted divider separates the five additional numerical tasks.
blocks.zh: 图6:拒绝差距扩大到其他依赖算术的任务。 菜单选择结果覆盖15个试点家庭,每个家庭有20对病例。 时间计算、容量四舍五入和日历算术显示选择 - 拒绝差距,而一些象征性任务在两种条件下都成功。 时间和计数显示其初步试点结果;点数分割器将另外五个数字任务分开.

blocks.en: Beyond bare expressions, we observe selection–rejection gaps in contextual inventory, purchase totals, time calculations, and capacity rounding ( Figure 6 ). Time calculations reproduce the gap on fresh cases despite perfect answer-present accuracy, while Boolean verification or directly supplying the result largely restores rejection. Capacity rounding and calendar arithmetic also show rejection failures in the smaller pilot sets, whereas object counting exhibits a milder gap. We hypothesize that the underlying arithmetic in these scenarios contributes to the bottleneck, with its severity depending on the task and operator structure.
blocks.zh: 除了赤裸的表达之外,我们观察到在背景清单、采购总额、时间计算和容量四舍五入方面的选择-拒绝差距(图6)。 时间计算复制了新病例上的空白,尽管答案的准确性是完美的,而布尔核查或直接提供结果则在很大程度上恢复拒绝。 能力四舍五入和日历算术还显示,在较小的试播集中,拒绝失败,而对象计数显示差距较小。 我们假设,这些假设中的基本算术助长了瓶颈,其严重程度取决于任务和操作结构。

blocks.en: Five additional numerical families receive 20 paired cases each; Figure 6 reports all 15 screens. State tracking, set intersection, rule chains, and scheduling succeed perfectly. Unit conversion scores 20/20 in both conditions, and fraction comparison scores 20/20 versus 19/20. In contrast, capacity rounding scores 18/20 versus 2/20; computing ⌈ 96 / 14 ⌉ = 7 \lceil 96/14\rceil=7 is a representative example. Calendar arithmetic scores 12/20 versus 0/20. Spatial navigation and string transformation have weaker answer-present performance, while program execution and interval overlap perform better with the answer absent.
blocks.zh: 另有5个家庭收到20对病例;图6报告所有15个屏幕。 状态跟踪,设置交叉点,规则链,以及排程都完美成功. 单位转换在两种条件下均得20/20分,分数比较得20/20对19/20分. 相形之下,容量四舍五入得分18/20对2/20;计算QQ 96/14 = 7\lceil 96/14\rceil=7是一个具有代表性的例子. 日历算术得分12/20对0/20. 空间导航和字符串转换具有较弱的解答表达性能,而程序执行和间隔重叠则在解答缺失的情况下表现较好.

blocks.en: To isolate wording, we rerun the same 100 arithmetic cases with Other and None of the above , preserving rejection criteria, candidate order, and inputs. Their present/absent accuracies are 99%/9% and 99%/6%, compared with the saved NONE baseline of 99%/7%. Separately, moving None across four positions recovers only 5, 0, 2, and 0 of 40 selected inventory failures. These results highlight that neither label substitution nor position changes provide a general repair, motivating the score-based calibration studied next.
blocks.zh: 为了孤立措辞,我们用上述其他和任何一种方法重审同样的100个算术案例,保留拒绝标准、候选人顺序和投入。 其目前/缺席率为99%/9%和99%/6%,而所节省的无经济效益基线为99%/7%。 另外,在40个选定的库存故障中,没有在4个位置上移动,只恢复了5、0、2和0个。 这些结果突出表明,标签替换和位置变化都无法提供一般的修复,激励接下来研究的基于分数的校准.

blocks.en: 5 Error Analysis and Threshold Calibration
blocks.zh: 5 错误分析和阈值校准

blocks.en: 5.1 Useful Scores, Incorrect Acceptance
blocks.zh: 5.1 有用分数、不正确接受

blocks.en: Figure 7: Score separation motivates threshold calibration. Empirical CDFs of Menu Choice rejection probabilities (left) and candidate truth scores for T/F Choice and Boolean (center/right). Answer-absent menus tend to receive higher rejection scores, while correct candidates generally receive higher truth scores than incorrect candidates. This separation motivates adjusting decision thresholds to reduce false acceptance. Gray dotted lines mark the default verification threshold; blue dashed lines mark development-selected thresholds.
blocks.zh: 图7 分数分离激励阈值校准. 实验性CDF 菜单选择排斥概率(左)和候选真理分数 T/F选择和布尔(中/右). 答题菜单往往得到的拒绝分数较高,而正确的考生得到的真相分数一般高于不正确的考生. 这种分离促使调整决定阈值以减少虚假接受. 灰色点线标记默认的验证阈值;蓝色的破折线标记开发选定的阈值.

blocks.en: The preceding controls show that the decision interface affects rejection. We next ask whether the returned scores retain enough information to repair these errors without changing the interface. In Figure 7 , arithmetic T/F Choice often assigns incorrect candidates truth scores above .5, although correct candidates generally receive higher scores. We quantify this separation using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC): the probability that a randomly chosen correct candidate scores above a randomly chosen incorrect candidate, with half credit for ties. An AUC of .5 indicates chance-level ordering and 1 indicates perfect ordering. Arithmetic T/F achieves an AUC of .985 despite only 88/200 exact-match menus; purchase T/F shows the same separation between ranking and decisions, with an AUC of .942 and 62/200 exact matches.
blocks.zh: 上述控制显示,决定界面影响拒绝. 我们接下来询问返回的分数是否保留足够的信息来修复这些错误而不改变接口. 在图7中,算术T/F Choice往往会给不正确的候选人分配超过5的真分数,尽管正确的候选人一般得到较高的分数. 我们使用接收器操作特征曲线(AUC)下的区域来量化这种分离:随机选择的正确候选人得分高于随机选择的不正确候选人的概率,连结的得分为一半. 5的AUC表示机会级订单,1表示完美级订单. 算术T/F尽管只有88/200的精确匹配菜单,却实现了9.85的AUC;购买T/F显示排名和决定的区别相同,AUC的精确匹配为942和62/200.

blocks.en: This strong ordering suggests that threshold placement contributes to the errors. Under the default .5 threshold, arithmetic T/F accepts multiple candidates on 55/200 menus, compared with 3/200 for Boolean; purchase exhibits the same pattern. Selecting the highest-scoring candidate would hide these conflicting judgments and would still require a separate rejection rule when every candidate is wrong. Instead, the score separation motivates calibrating the acceptance threshold while retaining all-candidate exact-match evaluation.
blocks.zh: 这种强烈的命令表明,放置阈值会造成错误。 在默认的5.阈值下,算术T/F在55/200菜单上接受多个考生,而布林3/200;购买显示模式相同. 选择得分最高的候选人会掩盖这些相互矛盾的判断,在每一个候选人都是错误的时,仍需要另外一项否决规则。 相反,分数分离激励了对验收阈值的校准,同时保留了所有候选人准确匹配的评价.

blocks.en: Menu Choice offers a related opportunity through a different score. Answer-absent menus often assign more probability to None than answer-present menus, even when None does not outrank the numerical alternatives. This motivates thresholding rejection probability directly. Thus candidate verification and menu selection call for different calibration rules, both using scores already returned by the model.
blocks.zh: 菜单选择通过不同的分数提供相关的机会. 解答缺席菜单往往给None分配的概率大于回答当前菜单,即使None没有排在数字替代的位次. 这直接激发了拒绝概率的阈值。 因此,候选人核查和菜单选择需要不同的校准规则,两者都使用模型已经返回的分数.

blocks.en: 5.2 A Development-Selected Decision Rule
blocks.zh: 5.2 发展选定决定规则

blocks.en:
Let p ∅ p_{\varnothing} be the probability of None and p i p_{i} the candidate probabilities. We replace categorical argmax with d ^ τ ​ ( x , C ) = { ∅ , p ∅ ≥ τ , arg ⁡ max i ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 } ⁡ p i , p ∅ < τ . \widehat{d}_{\tau}(x,C)=\begin{cases}\varnothing,&p_{\varnothing}\geq\tau,\\
\arg\max_{i\in\{1,2,3\}}p_{i},&p_{\varnothing}<\tau.\end{cases} (2) This rule checks whether the menu should be rejected before selecting a candidate, allowing rejection without requiring None to have the largest probability.

For candidate verification, we instead threshold each T/F or Boolean truth score s i s_{i} : z ^ i = 𝟏 [ s i ≥ τ ] \widehat{z}_{i}=\mathbf{1}[s_{i}\geq\tau] and retain all-three exact-match scoring. A higher threshold targets the false acceptances identified above; one positive selects a candidate, no positives rejects the menu, and multiple positives remain an error.
blocks.zh: 对于候选人验证,我们把每个T/F或布尔真理分数(s i s_{i}):z ^ i = 1 [si]\glash{z}_{i}=\mathbf{1} [s_{i}\geq\tau] 并保留所有三个精确的比分. 一个更高的阈值针对上面确定的虚假接受;一个正数选择一个候选人,没有正数拒绝菜单,多个正数仍然是一个错误.

blocks.en: To select an operating point that balances selection and rejection, we search τ ∈ { 0 , .01 , … , 1 } \tau\in\{0,.01,\ldots,1\} separately for each task/interface on 20 development problems, each with present and absent menus. The objective is mean case accuracy across the two balanced conditions; ties favor proximity to .5, then the smaller threshold. Arithmetic, lookup, and purchase use the earlier 20-case pilot for development and the disjoint 100-case transfer set for evaluation. Time and counting use their initial 20 for development and fresh 80 for evaluation. All calibration is performed offline on saved scores, and each selected threshold is applied unchanged to its evaluation set, requiring neither retraining nor additional inference.
blocks.zh: 要选择一个能平衡选择和拒绝的操作点, 我们搜索\\\\ { 0, 01,..., 1}\ tau\ in\\ 0,. 0, 01,\ ldots, 1\\\ 每个任务/接口, 分别处理20个发展问题, 每个任务/接口都有当前和没有的菜单 。 目标是两个均衡条件之间的平均案件准确性;关系倾向于接近5,然后是较小的门槛值。 算术,寻找,购买使用早期的20件实验开发,以及脱节的100件转移用于评价. 时间和计算使用其最初的20用于发展,新鲜的80用于评价。 所有校准都根据所节省的分数进行离线,每个选定的阈值对其评价套数适用不变,不需要再培训或附加推论.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Threshold adjustment recovers rejection on separate cases. (a) Arrows connect original menu decisions (open circles) to calibrated decisions (filled circles). Upward movement improves rejection; leftward movement loses selection accuracy. (b) Paired 95% bootstrap intervals quantify both effects. Arithmetic/purchase use 100 test cases; time/counting use 80. Thresholds are chosen only on the corresponding 20-case development sets.
blocks.zh: 图 8,阈值调整收回个别案件的驳回. (a) 箭头将原始菜单决定(开放圆圈)与校准决定(填充圆圈)联系起来。 向上移动会改善拒绝;向左移动会失去选择精度. (b) 95%的靴子间隔量化这两种效果。 算术/购买使用100个测试案例;时间/计算使用80个. 阈值只选择在相应的20个大小写开发集上.

blocks.en: 5.3 Held-Out Recovery and Tradeoffs
blocks.zh: 5.3 搁置的回收和权衡

blocks.en: Table 2: Original → \to calibrated correct counts. Arithmetic and purchase denominators are 100 per coverage; time and counting denominators are 80. Lookup remains 100/100 throughout at τ = .5 \tau=.5 . No evaluation labels are used to select thresholds.
blocks.zh: 表2: 原先的 \\\ 校准正确的计数。 算术和购买分母每覆盖100个;时间和计分母80个. 整个检查时间为100/100 = = 5\ tau= 5。 不使用评价标签来选择阈值 。

blocks.en: Table 2 and Figure 8 show that these development-selected thresholds recover rejection on held-out cases. For arithmetic menus, τ = .03 \tau=.03 raises correct rejection from 7% to 79% while retaining 97% answer-present accuracy, compared with 99% originally. Balanced accuracy therefore rises from 53% to 88%: the rejection gains substantially exceed the selection losses.
blocks.zh: 表2和图8显示,这些选定的发展阈值可收回被搁置案件的拒绝。 对于算术菜单,\\ = 03\ tau=. 03 将正确拒绝率从7%提高到79%,同时保留97%的答题准确率,而原先为99%。 因此,平衡的准确性从53%上升到88%:拒绝收益大大超过选择损失。

blocks.en: Candidate-level calibration likewise converts the strong score ordering into more accurate decisions. With τ = .74 \tau=.74 , arithmetic T/F exact match rises from 61%/27% to 86%/90% on present/absent menus. Boolean retains its default threshold of .5 and its 97%/99% accuracy. These results connect the score separation in Figure 7 to a practical correction of false acceptance.
blocks.zh: 候选人一级的校准同样将强分顺序转换为更准确的决定。 按=.74\tau=.74,计算T/F精确匹配率,在现/缺菜单上从61%/27%上升到86%/90%. Boolean保留其默认阈值为5. 及其97%/99 %的准确性. 这些结果将图7中的分数分离与对虚假接受的实际更正联系起来.

blocks.en: The same intervention also improves rejection beyond bare arithmetic. On fresh time cases, menu calibration increases rejection from 49/80 to 72/80 while preserving perfect selection. Purchase balanced accuracy improves from 59% to 82.5%, exchanging eight present-case successes for 55 absent-case rescues; counting exchanges two for five. Threshold calibration thus offers substantial recovery where the scores separate valid from invalid menus, with selection–rejection tradeoffs that vary by task.
blocks.zh: 同样的干预也改善了排斥程度,超出了赤裸的算术。 在新时间的情况下,菜单校准将拒绝次数从49/80增加到72/80,同时保持完美的选择。 采购平衡精度从59%提高到82.5%,交换了55次缺货救援的8次当前成功案例;计算交换5次。 因此,如果分数从无效菜单中分离出来,则阈值校准将带来很大的恢复,选择-拒绝取舍则因任务而异。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: Strong selection and Boolean verification show that Jev can solve the underlying problems, while supplying computed answers restores Menu Choice rejection. However, matched T/F Choice does not recover Boolean accuracy, showing that decomposition alone is insufficient. Together, these controls link the bottleneck to computation and decision interface. The gap extends to contextual arithmetic, time calculation, and capacity rounding, while successful lookup, symbolic controls, and multiplication/division chains reveal its task dependence.
blocks.zh: 强选择和布尔验证显示,Jev可以解决根本问题,同时提供计算答案恢复菜单选择拒绝. 然而,对应T/F 选择不能恢复布尔精度,表明单分解是不够的. 这些控制一起将瓶颈与计算和决策接口联系起来。 差距扩大到背景算术、时间计算和能力四舍五入,而成功的检索、象征性控制和乘法/分区链则揭示其任务依赖性。

blocks.en: In payment reconciliation and similar workflows, retrieved candidates may all be invalid. An explicit rejection option therefore needs evaluation on paired answer-present and answer-absent cases. Boolean verification changes the interface, whereas threshold calibration improves decisions from existing scores without retraining or additional inference. Their effectiveness should be assessed through both rejection gains and selection losses; deterministic computation offers another remedy when structured inputs permit it.
blocks.zh: 在付款调节和类似工作流程中,检索到的候选人可能都无效。 因此,明确拒绝选项需要评估对准的答案和对准的答案。 布尔校验会改变接口,而阈值校准则会改进现有分数中的决定,而无需再培训或附加推论. 应通过拒绝得益和选择损失来评估其有效性;当结构化投入允许时,确定性计算提供了另一种补救办法。

blocks.en: In this report, we identify an arithmetic-dependent rejection bottleneck in Jev despite strong selection accuracy. Through paired coverage tests, matched interfaces, and lookup controls, we show that categorical rejection can fail even when candidate verification succeeds. Motivated by score-distribution analysis, our threshold calibration substantially improves held-out rejection without retraining or additional inference. These findings support evaluating selection and rejection jointly. Future work includes real-world retrieval settings, cross-task calibration, and training for reliable rejection.
blocks.zh: 在本报告中,我们找出了Jev中一个依赖算术的拒绝瓶颈,尽管选择精准。 通过配对的覆盖测试,匹配的接口,以及查询控制,我们显示,即使候选人的验证成功,绝对拒绝也可能失败. 在分数分配分析的推动下,我们的阈值校准大大改进了不进行再培训或附加推论的拒绝。 这些调查结果支持共同评价甄选和拒绝。 今后的工作包括真实世界的检索设置、跨任务校准和可靠拒绝的培训。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: We evaluate Jev through its hosted API without access to model weights or internal activations. Our experiments and interpretations therefore characterize observable behavior through controlled inputs and returned outputs, rather than directly identifying the internal mechanisms behind the rejection bottleneck.
blocks.zh: 我们通过它的主机API来评价Jev,没有获得模型重量或内部激活. 因此,我们的实验和解释通过控制输入和返回产出来描述可观察到的行为,而不是直接确定拒绝瓶颈背后的内部机制。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: All experimental inputs are synthetic numerical or symbolic records without personal data. The study evaluates output reliability and does not execute financial, physical, or account actions. Its intended use is to improve validation of automated decisions and to make rejection errors visible alongside successful selection.
blocks.zh: 所有实验输入都是没有个人数据的合成数字或符号记录. 该研究评价产出的可靠性,不执行财务、实物或账户行动。 其预期用途是改进自动决定的验证,使否决错误与成功选择同时可见。
